name: payload-corrupt
description: usable plan W9.4: the runner's `prepare payload-corrupt` copies the payload the runner was given and truncates its clangd executable; server-arguments then points --payload at that copy (overriding the runner's own), so the server itself must detect the mismatch and report status error with issue payload-corrupt, instead of running clangd off a broken binary or leaving a request unanswered.
